definitions.HTTP: Instrumented client response read wall; JSON decoding and explicit post-response drain excluded.
definitions.workflow_span: First business start to last response end includes inter-request client/control gaps.
definitions.DB: Accepted all-role sendall-to-ReadyForQuery protocol wall; summed and union intervals, late request-origin calls retained.
definitions.data_SQL: All-role data statements per successful/expected-error business HTTP request; controls reported separately.
definitions.verification: Metric/proof/GIL/acceptance references and consumed HTTP seals checked; independent driver-level raw reaggregation separate.
definitions.setup: Orthogonal purpose counters: literal SELECT pg_export_snapshot(), SET TRANSACTION SNAPSHOT and SELECT pg_backend_pid(); these remain in the unchanged lexical data/control/TOTAL. No subtraction or relabeling.
definitions.scope: Primary workflow requests only, including snapshot/private-worker setup and all late origin-attributed calls through postresponse drain. Fixture import/bootstrap/admin ANALYZE excluded.
definitions.diagnostics: Direct enqueue/setup CPU/wall is separate; no precision-study expansion or HTTP-minus-DB CPU inference.
definitions.mechanism: Recursive_SQL counts actual all-role WITH RECURSIVE dispatches. Pool_jobs/tree_jobs count observed distinct native pool job IDs. Native tree counters are owner proof/publication/cache-path observations, not timely hits; unavailable old-mode counters remain absent. Correctness-only other apps are not new performance samples.
